title: The sky of a chosen time
description: A model for studying the past, with the range and the assumptions of the calculation stated.

blocks.text: A writer, a teacher or a researcher may need a sky other than tonight’s. What matters is understanding how well the result fits their question.

quote.text: Very very disappointed to discover that with the new version you can only go back to 1600 AD. This makes the tool totally useless for the work that I do.

blocks.text: Tie the place and date to a description of the calculation, let the parameters be saved and several versions compared.
Do not promise the same accuracy across millennia. Research use calls for a separate check of the model and the source data.
